title.value: Beyond Cosine Decay: On the effectiveness of Infinite Learning Rate Schedule for Continual Pre-training

extractions.description: An empirical study comparing the repeated cosine annealing learning rate schedule with an infinite (cosine) learning rate schedule for self-supervised continual pre-training, across small-scale MAE pre-training on CIFAR-10, large-scale MAE pre-training on ImageNet/Places2/FireRisk (plus an MRI dataset appendix experiment), and continual pre-training of a 570M LLaMA-3-architecture language model on DCLM-Baseline, Stack and German (OSCAR).

type.quote: Through extensive experiments across vision and language modalities, we believe that, to the best of our knowledge, we are the first to conduct a detailed comparison of infinite learning rate schedules with repeated annealing.
type.justification: The paper runs extensive experiments across vision and language domains.

name.quote: We present the first systematic study on the impact of learning rate schedules in non-IID self-supervised Continual Learning across both vision and language modalities.
name.justification: The paper studies continual pre-training and catastrophic forgetting, advancing this field.
